title: 卡文迪什住房管理员简报包
instruction:
您是为 Efua Oyelaran、Gerhard Gauthier、Mariam Bhandari、Joaquin Karlsson 和 Milena Navarro 准备卡文迪什住房信托联络中心简报包的编辑，他们将在 1 月份上任的第一天与其他八名管理员一起使用该简报。我们的运营主管 Iris Baranowski 需要一个实用的包，涵盖 1 月至明年 4 月期间可能发生的每一项重大变化，以便居民询问租金、服务费或支持资金。该清单并不保存在一个地方：监管机构的通知和决定、理事会网页、计划指南和我们的董事会会议记录并不总是使用相同的开始日期，有些事项仍然是协商而不是决定。 Bellwether Instruments 支持我们的联络中心平台，Drakemoor Laboratories 管理其中一项支持基金评估服务，因此我们收到的材料中也可能会提到来自这些组织的通知，但该包必须重点关注处理程序可以准确告诉居民的内容。使用完全相同的文件名在工作目录的顶层创建Cavendish_handler_briefing_pack.docx。将其控制在不超过六页，以便在实时通话期间轻松扫描，并包含更改时间表、每次更改的简单英语注释以及紧凑的问答卡。
将当前期间与一月至四月期间进行比较，并指出重大差异，包括任何时间或状态尚未确定的变化。展示此版本中发生的变化，并确定每个重要声明的基础和可信度；如果现有信息不支持，请勿发明日期、费率、阈值、权利或系统操作。处理人员需要可以与居民使用的语言，但他们不是福利顾问、律师、租金官员或投诉调查员，因此可以使用边界和升级点，而无需将包变成单独的专业程序。请使完成的文档可供新处理者使用，而无需询问其作者状态标签、日期、居民影响或升级说明的含义。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `Cavendish_handler_briefing_pack.docx` — 简洁的处理程序简报包，包含更改时间表、简单的英语解释、时期比较、来源和置信度指示、版本更改记录、边界指南以及紧凑的居民问答卡。 （呈现时不得超过六页。；必须为十一位联络中心处理人员在现场居民通话期间使用它而编写。；必须区分已确认、提议或咨询以及未解决的时间安排。；不得发明不受支持的日期、费率、阈值、权利或系统说明。；必须易于扫描，并且必须在没有作者简介的情况下独立存在。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
CAVENDISH  |  HOUSING TRUST
Handler briefing pack
For Efua Oyelaran, Gerhard Gauthier, Mariam Bhandari, Joaquin Karlsson, Milena Navarro and eight fellow contact-centre handlers.
COVERAGE HORIZON
January through the following April
Compare with the current period (information in force before the January return).
USE THIS PACK TO
Explain published position • qualify what is pending • route account or specialist questions.
Do not promise a rate, date, payment or outcome unless confirmed.
At a glance
Rent, service charges and support funds do not share one automatic annual cycle. A decision, its effective date and resident-facing implementation may be different events.
Status is explicit: CONFIRMED = usable as fact; PROPOSED / CONSULTED-ON = not in force; UNRESOLVED TIMING = subject or decision may exist, but commencement or implementation is not reliable.
When sources conflict, record the conflict, use the narrower safe wording, and refer for confirmation. A publication date is not automatically an operative date.
Confidence key
HIGH
MEDIUM
LOW / PENDING
HIGH: primary determination/approved Trust record is consistent.  MEDIUM: attributed guidance or operational notice, useful but needs scope check.  LOW / PENDING: consultation, conflicting dates or missing confirmation; never state as settled.
Scope guard
This is an information aid, not a benefits, legal, rent-officer or complaint-investigation procedure. Explain the published position; do not decide eligibility, interpret rights, amend an account, or investigate a complaint. Escalation directions are on page 4.


1 | Change schedule — January to April
Read each row across: subject → status → timing → resident impact → handler treatment. “Basis” identifies the source type available to the editor; no unsupported rate or threshold is inserted.
ID / subject
Status + confidence
Timing (what is known)
Resident impact
Handler treatment / basis
R1  Rent review / annual formula
CONFIRMED  • HIGH
Trust decision is recorded for the January–April period; exact effective date and amount are not reproduced here. Announcement, effective date and billing implementation must be checked separately.
A rent amount may differ from the current period when the Trust’s notice takes effect; no figure is promised in this pack.
Say: “A rent review is confirmed, but I must check the notice for your tenancy’s effective date and amount.” Basis: approved Trust/board record; confirm account application with Rent Accounts.
R2  Rent policy consultation
PROPOSED / CONSULTED-ON  • LOW / PENDING
Consultation or regulator material discusses a possible rule change during the horizon; no implementation decision or date is confirmed.
A possible future rule is not a current entitlement or charge.
Say “This is being considered, not implemented.” Do not forecast a rate. Basis: regulator notice / consultation; route policy questions to Housing Policy.
S1  Service-charge estimate
CONFIRMED  • HIGH
Annual estimate is issued on its service schedule; it may be dated differently from rent. Actual-cost reconciliation, if any, follows the service-charge process.
The service-charge line can move while rent does not, or vice versa. It represents services, not rent.
Say: “Your service charge pays for listed services and follows its own estimate/reconciliation.” Basis: approved service-charge budget/Trust notice; account-specific queries to Service Charge Team.
S2  Service cost / energy pass-through
UNRESOLVED TIMING  • MEDIUM
Provider cost information and Trust review are available, but commencement/implementation date is not settled; do not select the earliest date seen.
Any later adjustment may be shown on a service-charge statement, subject to confirmation and notice.
Say “We are checking the effective date; no change is confirmed from this notice alone.” Basis: provider notice + Trust review; escalate timing conflict to Service Charge Team.
F1  Support-fund assessment service
PROPOSED / CONSULTED-ON  • LOW / PENDING
Drakemoor Laboratories notice describes a possible assessment-service/process change; Trust adoption and start date are not confirmed.
A process change would not itself guarantee an award or change eligibility.
Say “Assessment is still subject to the published scheme and decision.” Basis: Drakemoor notice (administrator evidence, not Trust authority); route assessment questions to Welfare/Support Fund Team.
F2  Support-fund allocation / availability
UNRESOLVED TIMING  • LOW / PENDING
Council or scheme guidance indicates a funding window may change between January and April; allocation, threshold and start date await confirmation.
A fund being open or replenished does not mean every resident receives payment.
Say “We can record your question and refer it for an eligibility decision; I cannot promise funding.” Basis: council web guidance / scheme guidance; Welfare/Support Fund Team.
F3  External platform notice
CONFIRMED AS NOTICE ONLY  • MEDIUM
Bellwether Instruments may change contact-centre platform wording or display; no Trust resident charge or entitlement follows automatically.
A screen or message may look different; it does not change the resident’s rent or support outcome by itself.
Treat as supporting evidence only. Follow current approved Trust wording and report a mismatch to the contact-centre lead; do not invent a click path. Basis: Bellwether notice.
Status labels are operational: “confirmed” means the underlying decision is usable as fact, not that every account has already been updated. “Notice only” is not a resident outcome.


2 | Plain-English notes & period comparison
What to say about each topic
Rent — Rent is the charge for the home. The confirmed review may change the amount from the effective date in the Trust notice. It is separate from service charges and does not establish support-fund eligibility. If the resident’s account differs from the general notice, stop and refer to Rent Accounts.
Service charges — A service charge pays for specified services and is estimated or reconciled on its own timetable. A service-charge movement is not automatically a rent change. Explain the statement line and the relevant notice; do not calculate or infer a future amount when timing is unresolved.
Support funds — A support fund is a scheme or allocation that may help eligible residents. An open window, administrator notice or assessment-process change is not a guaranteed award. Eligibility, evidence and award decisions belong to the assessment/welfare function.
Timing rule — The familiar “one annual housing change” assumption stops applying when rent, service-charge and fund decisions have different decision, effective or implementation dates. In this horizon, R1 and S1 demonstrate separate cycles; S2 and F2 remain conditional.
Current period → January–April comparison
Topic
Current period (before January return)
January–April position
Why it matters on a call
Rent
Existing published rent information remains the reference until a valid Trust notice applies.
R1 review is confirmed; amount/effective date must come from the resident notice. R2 remains only a proposal.
Do not merge a proposed policy with the operative rent or quote a figure without the notice.
Service charges
Current estimate/statement is the reference for the current period.
S1 follows its service schedule; S2 may be reviewed but has no settled start date.
A resident can see rent and service charge move at different times and for different reasons.
Support funds
Existing scheme/assessment route applies unless the administering body says otherwise.
F1 process proposal and F2 funding timing are pending; no automatic award follows.
Record the question and refer rather than promise eligibility, payment or a date.
When information conflicts
Name the source type and the event it describes (announcement, decision, effective date or implementation).
If dates differ, do not choose one: use “date not confirmed” and refer to the owning team. The resident-facing answer is limited to what is consistent across sources.
If no reliable confirmation supports an answer, say so plainly, capture the minimum facts and escalate. This is a safe limitation, not a promise of a later outcome.


3 | Live-call Q&A card
Resident asks…
Handler answer (use or adapt)
What is changing?
There is a confirmed rent review and a confirmed service-charge estimate on separate schedules. Some policy, cost and support-fund items are proposed or still being timed. I can check the notice that applies to your account; this pack does not contain a rate or guarantee.
When does it change?
The announcement, effective date and the date it appears on an account may differ. Rent and service charges can have different dates; for S2 and F2 the start date is not confirmed. I will not guess—your owning team can confirm the applicable notice.
Does it apply to me?
It depends on your tenancy, service schedule and (for a fund) the scheme assessment. I can explain the general published position, but I cannot decide an individual account, eligibility or award.
Why did my rent and service charge not move together?
They are separate charges with separate bases and timetables. Rent follows the rent notice; service charge follows the services estimate or reconciliation. A difference does not by itself indicate an error.
Is the support fund guaranteed?
No. An open fund or assessment-process notice is not a guaranteed payment. Eligibility, evidence and the award decision sit with the Welfare/Support Fund Team or scheme administrator.
I saw a different date / message.
Thank you—sources can describe different events. I will record the wording and date, avoid treating it as final, and refer the conflict to the owning team for confirmation.
Boundaries & escalation
Do not decide / provide
Say instead
Route + capture before referral
Benefits eligibility or specialist assessment
“I can explain the published scheme position, not decide eligibility or an award.”
Welfare / Support Fund Team or named scheme assessor. Capture fund/topic, relevant date, resident question, and any stated deadline.
Legal advice or interpretation of rights
“I cannot give legal advice or interpret your rights.”
Legal Counsel / approved rights service. Capture the issue, document/date cited, and resident’s question—do not offer a view.
Account-specific rent/service-charge determination
“The general note cannot decide what is on your account.”
Rent Accounts or Service Charge Team. Capture account reference, charge line, notice/date, and mismatch described.
Complaint investigation or outcome
“I can record the concern, but I cannot investigate or decide it here.”
Complaints function. Capture concern, event/date, requested outcome and relevant correspondence.


4 | Edition record, sources & handoff
What changed in this edition
Affected topic
Edition change
Handler consequence
All topics / timing
Added explicit decision → effective date → implementation convention and conflict treatment.
Do not equate publication with a live account change.
Rent + service charges
Separated rent review (R1) from service-charge estimate/reconciliation (S1) and unresolved cost timing (S2).
Explain why charges may move apart; refer mismatches.
Support funds
Added proposed assessment-service item (F1) and unresolved allocation timing (F2), with no automatic-award wording.
Qualify every fund answer; route eligibility.
Call handling
Added Q&A card, status/confidence key and boundary routes.
Use the scripts; capture facts before referral.
Source register (source type, scope and confidence)
Source type used
What it can support
Limits / treatment
Approved Trust / board record
Confirmed rent or service-charge decision and internal scope.
Still check notice, effective date and account implementation separately.
Regulator notice or consultation
A policy position, proposal or consultation status.
Not a Trust implementation or resident entitlement until adopted and effective.
Council or scheme guidance
External funding window or scheme process information.
Attribution required; thresholds, allocations and dates remain pending if not confirmed.
Provider notice — Bellwether Instruments / Drakemoor Laboratories
Evidence about platform display or an assessment service.
Supporting evidence only; does not create a Trust-wide charge, award or system instruction.
Quick handoff checklist
Capture resident question, subject (rent / service charge / fund), relevant notice or date, account or tenancy context, and the uncertainty or mismatch reported.
Use “confirmed”, “proposed / consulted-on” or “unresolved timing” exactly as defined. Never fill a gap with an estimated rate, threshold, payment, date or outcome.
This pack is current for the January–April planning horizon; the owning team’s later approved notice supersedes it. No other topic is changed by this edition unless listed above.

criteria.description: 提交的内容是一个名为 Cavendish_handler_briefing_pack.docx 的可读 DOCX 文件。
criteria.evidence: 提交的文件名和成功的 DOCX 解析。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查顶级文件名以及该文件是否作为有效的 Word 文档打开。

original.criterion: The submission is a readable DOCX file named Cavendish_handler_briefing_pack.docx.
original.evidence: Submitted filename and successful DOCX parsing.
original.grader_hint: Check the top-level filename and that the file opens as a valid Word document.

criteria.description: 渲染的简报包不超过六页。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用离线 Office 渲染器渲染 DOCX 并计数页面；六个或更少的人获得学分。

original.criterion: The rendered briefing pack is no more than six pages.
original.grader_hint: Render the DOCX with an offline office renderer and count pages; six or fewer earns credit.

criteria.description: 该文件将卡文迪什住房信托基金及其目标受众确定为联络中心处理人员。
criteria.evidence: 标题、副标题或观众陈述。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找信任身份和明确的处理程序受众声明。

original.criterion: The document identifies Cavendish Housing Trust and its intended audience as contact-centre handlers.
original.grader_hint: Look for both the Trust identity and a clear handler audience statement.

criteria.description: 该文件规定了一月至明年四月的运营期限。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受同等声明，即该包涵盖一月到次年四月。

original.criterion: The document states the January-to-next-April operating horizon.
original.grader_hint: Accept an equivalent statement that the pack covers January through the following April.

criteria.description: 该时间表涵盖了所有三个要求的主题领域：租金、服务费和支持资金。
criteria.evidence: 安排条目或明确标记的主题组。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证每个主题领域至少有一个实质性更改或状态条目，而不仅仅是标题中的提及。

original.criterion: The schedule covers all three requested subject areas: rent, service charges, and support funds.
original.evidence: Schedule entries or clearly labelled subject groups.
original.grader_hint: Verify that each subject area has at least one substantive change or status entry, not merely a mention in the title.

criteria.description: 该时间表呈现了多个不同的变更或变更主题，而不是一个通用的年度更新。
criteria.evidence: 不同的时间表行或卡片。
criteria.grader_hint: 统计实质性不同的变更主题；对一项更改的重复措辞不符合覆盖范围。

original.criterion: The schedule presents multiple distinct changes or change topics rather than one generic annual update.
original.grader_hint: Count substantively different change topics; repeated wording for one change does not qualify as coverage.

criteria.description: 每个时间表条目都有可识别的主题、状态、时间、居民影响和面向处理者的处理。
criteria.evidence: 明细表字段和链接的注释。
criteria.grader_hint: 走每一个换行；仅当所有五个维度都可以在不进行推理的情况下找到时才奖励。

original.criterion: Each schedule entry has an identifiable subject, status, timing, resident impact, and handler-facing treatment.
original.grader_hint: Walk every change row; award only if all five dimensions can be located without inference.

criteria.description: 该时间表将已确认的变更与协商或建议区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的标签，例如已确认、已提议、已咨询、待定或类似标签。

original.criterion: The schedule distinguishes confirmed changes from consultations or proposals.
original.grader_hint: Look for explicit labels such as confirmed, proposed, consulted-on, pending, or equivalent.

criteria.description: 该文件并未将咨询或建议作为已实施的变更提出。
criteria.evidence: 状态标签与注释和问答中的措辞的比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查未来或不确定的事项是否使用条件语言，而不是描述为当前的权利或费用。

original.criterion: The document does not present a consultation or proposal as an implemented change.
original.evidence: Comparison of status labels with wording in notes and Q&A.
original.grader_hint: Check that future or uncertain matters use conditional language and are not described as current entitlements or charges.

criteria.description: 如果启动日期不同或仍未确定，该文件保留不确定性并给出安全的操作解释。
criteria.evidence: 计时字段和解释性注释。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的未解决或冲突的日期处理方式，而不是默默选择的日期。

original.criterion: Where commencement dates differ or remain unsettled, the document preserves the uncertainty and gives a safe operational interpretation.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit unresolved or conflicting-date treatment rather than a silently selected date.

criteria.description: 该文件区分了公告、决定、生效日期和面向居民的实施，其中这些不是同一事件。
criteria.evidence: 时间表或注释中的日期/状态语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 当工件避免将发布日期视为自动等于操作日期时授予奖励。

original.criterion: The document distinguishes an announcement, decision, effective date, and resident-facing implementation where those are not the same event.
original.evidence: Date/status language in schedule or notes.
original.grader_hint: Award when the artifact avoids treating publication date as automatically equal to operative date.

criteria.description: 该包包括每个材料更改的明确基础或来源类型指示。
criteria.evidence: 来源或基础列、脚注或链接的注释标签。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受监管机构的决定、理事会页面、计划指南、董事会会议纪要、提供商通知或明确标记的专业依据。

original.criterion: The pack includes an explicit basis or source-type indication for each material change.
original.evidence: Source or basis column, footnotes, or linked note labels.
original.grader_hint: Accept regulator determination, council page, scheme guidance, board minute, provider notice, or a clearly marked professional basis.

criteria.description: 该包不会伪造引文、URL、文档编号或引文来创建虚假权威。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查引用是否仅在可支持的情况下才具体，以及不确定的出处是否被标记而不是发明。

original.criterion: The pack does not fabricate citations, URLs, document numbers, or quotations to create false authority.
original.grader_hint: Check whether references are specific only where supportable and whether uncertain provenance is labelled rather than invented.

criteria.description: 重要的定量或资格主张要么有确定的基础支持，要么明确保留等待确认。
criteria.evidence: 费率、阈值、日期和权利措辞。
criteria.grader_hint: 当精确值无法证明合理时，受限制的“未确认”处理会赢得信用。

original.criterion: Important quantitative or eligibility claims are either supported by an identified basis or explicitly withheld pending confirmation.
original.evidence: Rates, thresholds, dates, and entitlement wording.
original.grader_hint: A restrained 'not confirmed' treatment earns credit when a precise value cannot be justified.

criteria.description: 该文件包括重要陈述的信心或确定性指示。
criteria.evidence: 置信度标签、确定性密钥或同等内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证标签是否已定义并在实质性条目上使用。

original.criterion: The document includes a confidence or certainty indication for important statements.
original.evidence: Confidence labels, certainty key, or equivalent.
original.grader_hint: Verify that the labels are defined and used on substantive entries.

criteria.description: 置信约定将已确认的信息与等待确认的信息区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅有传说是不够的；检查条目是否一致地使用它。

original.criterion: The confidence convention distinguishes confirmed information from information awaiting confirmation.
original.grader_hint: A legend alone is insufficient; inspect whether entries use it consistently.

criteria.description: 该包将当前时期与一月至四月时期进行比较。
criteria.evidence: 比较表或明确的前后部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要两个可识别的时期和实质性比较，而不仅仅是两个日期标题。

original.criterion: The pack compares the current period with the January-to-April period.
original.evidence: Comparison table or explicit before/after section.
original.grader_hint: Require two identifiable periods and substantive comparison, not merely two date headings.

criteria.description: 期间比较解释了为什么每种实质性差异对居民或处理人员都很重要。
criteria.evidence: 比较中的影响或意义栏。
criteria.grader_hint: 没有操作意义的数字或日期差异不会获得此项目。

original.criterion: The period comparison explains why each material difference matters to a resident or handler.
original.evidence: Impact or meaning column in the comparison.
original.grader_hint: A numerical or date difference without operational meaning does not earn this item.

criteria.description: 该文件指出，住房变化遵循一个年度周期的熟悉假设何时不再适用于所涵盖的主题。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找涵盖不同周期、年中变化、咨询或特定服务时间安排的明确例外原则。

original.criterion: The document states when the familiar assumption that a housing change follows one annual cycle stops applying across the covered topics.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit exception principle covering differing cycles, mid-year changes, consultations, or service-specific timing.

criteria.description: 时间例外适用于至少两个不同的主题领域，而不是抽象地表述。
criteria.evidence: 租金、服务费或支持基金示例。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证工件是否通过具体的计划条目演示了异常。

original.criterion: The timing exception is applied to at least two different subject areas rather than stated abstractly.
original.grader_hint: Verify that the artifact demonstrates the exception with concrete schedule entries.

criteria.description: 该资料包以适合居民的通俗易懂的语言解释了租金变化。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找关于哪些内容发生变化、何时发生变化以及哪些内容仍然未知的易于理解的解释。

original.criterion: The pack explains rent changes in plain language suitable for a resident.
original.grader_hint: Look for an intelligible explanation of what changes, when, and what remains unknown.

criteria.description: 租金措辞将租金金额或规则与任何单独的服务费或支持基金问题分开。
criteria.grader_hint: 当文件避免将所有居民付款呈现为一项无差别的变化时授予。

original.criterion: Rent wording separates the rent amount or rule from any separate service charge or support-fund issue.
original.grader_hint: Award when the document avoids presenting all resident payments as one undifferentiated change.

criteria.description: 该资料包以适合居民的通俗易懂的语言解释了服务费的变化。
criteria.evidence: 服务费说明或问答回复。
criteria.grader_hint: 解释必须说明服务费代表什么以及时间或金额与租金有何不同。

original.criterion: The pack explains service-charge changes in plain language suitable for a resident.
original.grader_hint: The explanation must address what a service charge represents and how timing or amount may differ from rent.

criteria.description: 服务费措辞避免暗示每次服务费变动都是租金变化。
criteria.evidence: 定义和面向居民的措辞。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查这两个类别之间是否存在明显区别。

original.criterion: Service-charge wording avoids implying that every service-charge movement is a rent change.
original.grader_hint: Check for a clear distinction between the two categories.

criteria.description: 该资料包以适合居民的通俗易懂的语言解释了支持基金的变化。
criteria.evidence: 支持基金说明或问答回复。
criteria.grader_hint: 解释必须涵盖状态、时间以及与资金相关的变更可能不等于自动付款的事实。

original.criterion: The pack explains support-fund changes in plain language suitable for a resident.
original.grader_hint: The explanation must cover status, timing, and the fact that a fund-related change may not equal automatic payment.

criteria.description: 支持基金的措辞将可用性或流程变更与有保证的个人奖励区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 谨慎对待评估、资格、资金限制或待决决定。

original.criterion: Support-fund wording distinguishes availability or process changes from a guaranteed individual award.
original.grader_hint: Look for careful treatment of assessment, eligibility, funding limits, or pending decisions.

criteria.description: 该文档定义或解释了计划中使用的每个状态标签。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试所有标签，包括缩写和置信标记。

original.criterion: The document defines or explains every status label used in the schedule.
original.grader_hint: Test all labels, including abbreviations and confidence markers.

criteria.description: 处理程序可以从每个条目中判断更改是否已生效、将来的、有条件的或尚未确认。
criteria.grader_hint: 遍历每个状态类别的代表性条目。

original.criterion: A handler can tell from each entry whether the change is already in force, future-dated, conditional, or not yet confirmed.
original.grader_hint: Walk representative entries from each status category.

criteria.description: 该套装包含一张紧凑的问答卡。
criteria.evidence: 清晰标记的问答卡或等效的快速参考块。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要一个独特的、可快速浏览的组件，而不是分散的问题。

original.criterion: The pack includes a compact Q&A card.
original.evidence: Clearly labelled Q&A card or equivalent quick-reference block.
original.grader_hint: Require a distinct, quickly scannable component rather than scattered questions.

criteria.description: 问答卡涵盖居民询问正在发生变化的内容、变化的时间以及变化是否适用于他们。
criteria.grader_hint: 所有三个居民关心的问题都必须有直接代表。

original.criterion: The Q&A card covers a resident asking what is changing, when it changes, and whether it applies to them.
original.evidence: Questions and answers in the card.
original.grader_hint: All three resident concerns must be directly represented.

criteria.description: 问答卡包括对未解决或咨询的变更的响应。
criteria.grader_hint: 答复必须避免将未决事项视为最终决定。

original.criterion: The Q&A card includes a response for an unsettled or consulted-on change.
original.grader_hint: The response must avoid presenting a pending matter as final.

criteria.description: 问答卡包含对居民询问为何租金和服务费不同步变动的答复。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找单独的基础或时间的简明解释。

original.criterion: The Q&A card includes a response for a resident who asks why their rent and service charge do not move together.
original.grader_hint: Look for a concise explanation of separate bases or timing.

criteria.description: 问答卡包括对居民询问支持资金是否有保障的答复。
criteria.grader_hint: 回应必须保留评估或资格的不确定性。

original.criterion: The Q&A card includes a response for a resident asking whether a support fund is guaranteed.
original.grader_hint: The response must preserve assessment or eligibility uncertainty.

criteria.description: 该包告诉处理人员他们可以陈述什么是事实，以及他们必须将什么认定为待定、估计或未经确认。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找可用的措辞或事实与条件的约定。

original.criterion: The pack tells handlers what they may state as fact and what they must qualify as pending, estimated, or unconfirmed.
original.grader_hint: Look for usable phrasing or a factual-versus-conditional convention.

criteria.description: 该包给出了明确的界限，即处理人员不得确定专家福利的资格。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件必须禁止越界，而不仅仅是指定另一个团队。

original.criterion: The pack gives a clear boundary that handlers must not determine specialist benefits eligibility.
original.grader_hint: The document must prohibit overstepping, not merely name another team.

criteria.description: 该包给出了明确的界限，即处理人员不得提供法律建议或解释居民的合法权利。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受直接限制和适当的推荐。

original.criterion: The pack gives a clear boundary that handlers must not provide legal advice or interpret a resident's legal rights.
original.grader_hint: Accept a direct limitation paired with an appropriate referral.

criteria.description: 该包给出了明确的界限，即处理人员不得在其职责之外做出或调查租赁账户或投诉决定。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找解释已发布信息和判决案件之间的区别。

original.criterion: The pack gives a clear boundary that handlers must not make or investigate a rent-account or complaint determination outside their role.
original.grader_hint: Look for a distinction between explaining published information and deciding a case.

criteria.description: 每个专家边界都配有实际的升级或转介方向。
criteria.grader_hint: 没有可用目的地的禁令不会获得该物品的积分。

original.criterion: Each specialist boundary is paired with a practical escalation or referral direction.
original.grader_hint: A prohibition without a usable destination earns no credit for this item.

criteria.description: 该文件确定了有关个人租金或服务费账户申请的问题的途径。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受命名的内部函数或角色，而不需要发明的本地代码。

original.criterion: The document identifies a route for questions about individual rent or service-charge account application.
original.grader_hint: Accept a named internal function or role, without requiring an invented local code.

criteria.description: 该文件确定了支持基金资格或评估问题的途径。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受相关评估或福利支持职能。

original.criterion: The document identifies a route for support-fund eligibility or assessment questions.
original.grader_hint: Accept the relevant assessment or welfare-support function.

criteria.description: 该文件确定了解决法律或基于权利的问题的途径。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受法律顾问或适当的专家服务。

original.criterion: The document identifies a route for legal or rights-based questions.
original.grader_hint: Accept legal counsel or an appropriate specialist service.

criteria.description: 升级指南告诉处理程序在转介之前要捕获哪些信息。
criteria.evidence: 推荐清单或呼叫处理说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要有用的最低限度背景信息，例如居民问题、受影响的费用或基金、相关日期和不确定性。

original.criterion: Escalation guidance tells the handler what information to capture before referral.
original.grader_hint: Require useful minimum context such as resident question, affected charge or fund, relevant date, and uncertainty.

criteria.description: 该包避免指示处理者承诺付款、固定金额、实施日期或未确认的结果。
criteria.evidence: 问答和处理程序语言审查。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查承诺的示例和脚本；如果状态不确定，则需要有条件措辞。

original.criterion: The pack avoids instructing handlers to promise a payment, fixed amount, implementation date, or outcome that is not confirmed.
original.grader_hint: Check examples and scripts for promises; conditional wording is required where status is uncertain.

criteria.description: 该包告诉处理人员当居民的情况或帐户与一般变更说明不符时如何应对。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找停止和检查或转介原则，而不是一揽子申请规则。

original.criterion: The pack tells handlers how to respond when the resident's circumstances or account do not match the general change note.
original.grader_hint: Look for a stop-and-check or referral principle rather than a blanket application rule.

criteria.description: 该文档记录了此版本中的更改内容。
criteria.evidence: 更改日志、版本说明或修订声明。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要实质性变更描述，而不仅仅是版本号。

original.criterion: The document records what changed in this edition.
original.evidence: Change log, edition note, or revision statement.
original.grader_hint: Require substantive change description, not only a version number.

criteria.description: 版本更改记录标识受影响的主题和更改的性质。
criteria.grader_hint: 每个列出的修订都应可追溯至租金、服务费、支持资金、时间安排、状态或指导。

original.criterion: The edition-change record identifies the affected topic and the nature of the change.
original.grader_hint: Each listed revision should be traceable to rent, service charges, support funds, timing, status, or guidance.

criteria.description: 该文件标识了保持不变或超出当前确认范围的项目，这种区别可以防止处理程序混淆。
criteria.grader_hint: 当包阻止仅仅因为讨论某个主题而推断出隐含的更改时，将授予奖励。

original.criterion: The document identifies items that remain unchanged or are outside the current confirmed scope where that distinction prevents handler confusion.
original.grader_hint: Award when the pack prevents an implied change from being inferred merely because a topic is discussed.

criteria.description: 该文件将外部或支持组织的通知视为评估证据，而不是对卡文迪什居民结果的自动权威。
criteria.evidence: 涉及外部通知的源/边界处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查外部信息是否符合上下文，并且没有转换为不受支持的信任承诺。

original.criterion: The document treats notices from external or supporting organisations as evidence to assess, not automatic authority over Cavendish resident outcomes.
original.grader_hint: Check that external information is contextualised and not converted into an unsupported Trust commitment.

criteria.description: 该包将信任级信息与属于理事会、监管机构、计划管理员或专业提供商的信息区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找归属和范围，尤其是支持基金材料。

original.criterion: The pack distinguishes Trust-level information from information belonging to a council, regulator, scheme administrator, or specialist provider.
original.grader_hint: Look for attribution and scope, especially for support-fund material.

criteria.description: 该文件对冲突信息提供了一致的处理方式，而不是选择最方便的日期或声明而不进行解释。
criteria.evidence: 冲突注释、状态约定或时间表示例。
criteria.grader_hint: 当工件记录冲突、限制索赔并确定必须确认的内容时授予奖励。

original.criterion: The document provides a consistent treatment for conflicting information rather than selecting the most convenient date or statement without explanation.
original.evidence: Conflict note, status convention, or schedule examples.
original.grader_hint: Award when the artifact records the conflict, limits the claim, and identifies what must be confirmed.

criteria.description: 时间表和简单的英文注释就每个涵盖的变更的状态和时间达成一致。
criteria.evidence: 根据笔记交叉阅读时间表。
criteria.grader_hint: 对所有条目进行抽样；日期或确定性上的矛盾不符合该项目。

original.criterion: The schedule and plain-English notes agree on status and timing for every covered change.
original.grader_hint: Sample all entries; contradictions in date or certainty fail this item.

criteria.description: 问答答案与相同变更主题的时间表和注释一致。
criteria.evidence: 与其他内容交叉阅读问答。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查快速参考措辞是否不会简化材料限定。

original.criterion: The Q&A answers agree with the schedule and notes on the same change topics.
original.evidence: Cross-reading Q&A against the rest of the pack.
original.grader_hint: Check that quick-reference wording does not simplify away a material qualification.

criteria.description: 该包使用居民友好的语言并解释了不可避免的技术术语。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断新处理人员是否可以向居民重复这些措辞，而无需翻译无法解释的行话。

original.criterion: The pack uses resident-friendly language and explains unavoidable technical terms.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether a new handler could repeat the wording to a resident without translating unexplained jargon.

criteria.description: 该包在实时通话期间确实可用：标题、状态提示、表格和问答内容使处理人员能够快速找到相关答案。
criteria.grader_hint: 审阅者应该测试几个可能的常驻问题并判断导航、可浏览性和易读性，而不是奖励装饰。

original.criterion: The pack is genuinely usable during a live call: headings, status cues, tables, and Q&A content allow a handler to find the relevant answer quickly.
original.grader_hint: A reviewer should test several likely resident questions and judge navigation, scanability, and legibility rather than rewarding decoration.

criteria.description: 该包足够独立，新处理程序可以使用，而无需询问其作者状态、日期、居民影响或升级指令的含义。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断实际独立性；无法解释的标签、模糊的推荐或日程安排和问答之间缺少链接都应该失去信誉。

original.criterion: The pack is self-contained enough for a new handler to use without asking its author what a status, date, resident impact, or escalation instruction means.
original.grader_hint: Judge practical independence; unexplained labels, vague referrals, or missing links between schedule and Q&A should lose credit.

criteria.description: 该包规定了当没有可靠的确认支持答案时处理程序应该做什么，而不将该声明转化为发明的系统过程。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找安全的限制和推荐方法，同时确认不需要伪造的软件点击路径或内部代码。

original.criterion: The pack states what handlers should do when no reliable confirmation supports an answer, without turning that statement into an invented system procedure.
original.grader_hint: Look for a safe limitation-and-referral approach, while confirming that no fabricated software click path or internal code is required.

spec.professional_context: This is an enterprise housing contact-centre briefing artifact for handlers answering resident questions about rent, service charges, and support funds across a changing January-to-April operating period. The editor must turn dispersed and partly conflicting policy information into a restrained, usable, evidence-aware document without crossing into specialist advice.
difficulty_sources: The schedule of changes must be assembled from professional knowledge rather than supplied source files.
The document must distinguish confirmed changes from consultations and unresolved commencement dates.
A commonly used annual-change assumption does not apply uniformly across rent, service charges, and support funds.
Support-fund and benefits content overlaps with specialist functions, requiring a clear boundary without giving legal or eligibility advice.

artifact.purpose: Create a compact, reusable handler-facing normative pack with a schedule, explanatory notes, comparison, edition record, boundaries, and Q&A card.
content_constraints: Use a January-to-next-April horizon and compare it with the current period.
Include the three subject domains: rent, service charges, and support funds.
Use generic but professionally plausible recurring change categories; do not rely on live facts or invented exact figures.
Mark confirmed, proposed or consulted-on, and unresolved items distinctly.
Make uncertain or unsupported values visibly conditional or pending.
Include source-type attribution without fabricating citations.
Include a plain-language resident impact and a handler-facing statement for each material item.
Include a timing convention explaining that the familiar annual cycle is not universal: rent, service charges, and support funds can follow different decision, effective, and implementation dates.
Include boundaries for benefits eligibility, legal advice or rights interpretation, account-specific determinations, and complaint investigation, with a useful specialist destination for each.
Include an edition-change record and a defined status/confidence legend.
Keep the rendered artifact at six pages or fewer.

coverage_model: At least six substantively distinct change topics spanning the three subject domains, including at least one confirmed-style item, one consulted-on or proposed item, and one unresolved-timing item.
For each topic, derive a tuple of subject, status, timing, basis, confidence, resident impact, handler wording, and escalation condition.
Derive the period comparison from the same topic tuples so the comparison cannot contradict the schedule.

Derive Q&A prompts from likely live-call questions: what changed, when, whether it applies, why rent and service charges differ, whether support is guaranteed, and what to do when information is pending.
Derive boundary checks from the occupational distinction between explaining published information and making specialist eligibility, legal, account, or complaint decisions.
Derive the rule-of-thumb check from the annual-cycle assumption and require the artifact to identify exceptions across at least two subject areas.

Derive the external-organisation check by requiring attribution and scope treatment for notices associated with Bellwether Instruments or Drakemoor Laboratories, without making either organisation the source of a Trust-wide entitlement.
gold_derivation.review_method: Render the DOCX offline, inspect page count and legibility, then walk the schedule row by row and cross-check every corresponding note and Q&A answer. Test the artifact with hypothetical questions about a confirmed rent change, a pending service-charge matter, an unresolved support-fund date, a mismatched resident circumstance, and a legal or eligibility question.

deliverables.description: A concise handler briefing pack containing a change schedule, plain-English explanations, period comparison, source and confidence indications, edition-change record, boundary guidance, and a compact resident Q&A card.
constraints: Must be no more than six pages when rendered.
Must be written for eleven contact-centre handlers using it during live resident calls.
Must distinguish confirmed, proposed or consulted-on, and unresolved timing.
Must not invent unsupported dates, rates, thresholds, entitlements, or system instructions.
Must be practical to scan and must stand alone without an author briefing.

original_instruction:
You are the editor preparing Cavendish Housing Trust's contact-centre briefing pack for Efua Oyelaran, Gerhard Gauthier, Mariam Bhandari, Joaquin Karlsson and Milena Navarro, who will use it with the other eight handlers on their first day back in January. Our operations lead, Iris Baranowski, needs one practical pack covering every material change that may land between January and next April for residents asking about rent, service charges or support funds. The list is not held in one place: notices and determinations from the regulator, council web pages, scheme guidance, and our board minutes do not always use the same commencement date, and some matters are still consultations rather than decisions. Bellwether Instruments supports our contact-centre platform and Drakemoor Laboratories administers one of the support-fund assessment services, so notices from those organisations may also be mentioned in the material we receive, but the pack must stay focused on what a handler can accurately tell a resident. Create Cavendish_handler_briefing_pack.docx in the top level of the working directory, using exactly that filename. Keep it to no more than six pages, make it easy to scan during a live call, and include a change schedule, plain-English notes for each change, and a compact Q&A card. Compare the current period with the January-to-April period and call out material differences, including any change whose timing or status is not settled. Show what has changed in this edition and identify the basis and confidence of each important statement; do not invent a date, rate, threshold, entitlement, or system action where the available information does not support it. The handlers need language they can use with residents, but they are not benefits advisers, lawyers, rent officers or complaint investigators, so make the boundary and escalation points usable without turning the pack into a separate specialist procedure. Please make the finished document something a new handler can use without asking its author what a status label, date, resident impact or escalation instruction means.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `Cavendish_handler_briefing_pack.docx` — A concise handler briefing pack containing a change schedule, plain-English explanations, period comparison, source and confidence indications, edition-change record, boundary guidance, and a compact resident Q&A card. (Must be no more than six pages when rendered.; Must be written for eleven contact-centre handlers using it during live resident calls.; Must distinguish confirmed, proposed or consulted-on, and unresolved timing.; Must not invent unsupported dates, rates, thresholds, entitlements, or system instructions.; Must be practical to scan and must stand alone without an author briefing.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
